Appraiser remarks
The vehicle presents with a crushed front bumper cover, a cracked right headlamp
assembly, and a bent hood latch support, consistent with a frontal impact during a left
turn. Some of the lower radiator support damage may have resulted from this event,
though it is not clearly separable from the impact at hand. The repair plan calls for
replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, straightening the latch support, and
refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours submitted fit the scope of the
visible damage, and the parts and charges listed appear once each with no repeated
entries. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or the inspection.
